UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered informal waste collector, formal recycler representative, or platform admin

phone.description: Verified Indian phone number formatted with +91 prefix

role.description: User role: collector, recycler, or admin

preferredLanguage.description: Language code for the interface (hi, en, mr, ta, bn)

location.description: Ward, locality, or operating hub description

verified.description: Whether the identity has undergone verification

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of user profile registration

RecyclerRecord.title: RecyclerRecord
RecyclerRecord.description: Formal e-waste recycling facility with CPCB compliance record and live rate card

name.description: Company name of the authorized recycling facility

location.description: Physical facility address or industrial estate zone

verificationStatus.description: Formal compliance status: verified or unverified

cpcbRegistrationNo.description: Central Pollution Control Board official registration code

is_test.description: Flag marking whether this facility is test data

TransactionRecord.title: TransactionRecord
TransactionRecord.description: Tamper-evident record of an e-waste handover between collector and verified recycler

collectorPhone.description: Phone number of informal collector initiating pickup

weightKg.description: Estimated or weighed mass in kilograms

finalWeightKg.description: Scale-confirmed weight recorded upon physical check-in

finalPrice.description: Final settlement price paid to collector

is_test.description: Whether this transaction is generated under Guided Test Mode

ConnectionTest.title: ConnectionTest
ConnectionTest.description: Healthcheck document for verifying Firestore client connectivity on initial boot

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles including informal collectors, recyclers, and platform admins

/recyclers/{recyclerId}.description: Authorized CPCB recycling facilities with live published rate cards

/transactions/{transactionId}.description: Tamper-evident audit trail of e-waste handovers

/test/{testId}.description: Diagnostic document for getDocFromServer boot verification
